title: 12 Preludes, Op.63 - No. 1
notable_excerpt: Key: A minor. Chord journey: v6 - i5 - v6 - v - bVII6 - iii5 - bVII6 - bvii - bvii4 - #iiio b5 - vio4 - bvi4 - iio5 - i64 - i - i, closes on a cadential i64. Texture: single melodic line in the right hand over a sparse low bass with occasional chordal turns.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
